## Workflow

1. **Parse task constraints first.** Record grid dimensions, allowed actions, demo-request limit, submission cap, feedback type, and required response format.

Identify the complete changed-cell set and characterize it geometrically (rows, columns, rays, components, bounding box, recoloring, movement, etc.). Check whether values are deleted, preserved, or recolored.
